name: null3d-workspace
description: A browser 3D engine for games and heavy 3D apps: Rust and WebAssembly on worker threads, WebGPU and WebGL2, and a TypeScript API with three.js-style names.

scripts.skills: bun tools/skills.ts sync && bun tools/skills.ts check
scripts.typecheck: bun tools/shaders.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/engine/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/controls && tsc -p packages/controls/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/cli && tsc -p tests/pages && tsc -p tests/fixtures/project && tsc -p examples && tsc -p bench && tsc -p bench/tsconfig.node.json
scripts.test: bun tools/shaders.ts && bun test tools packages bench/scenes bench/pages bench/lib tests/lib
scripts.test:shader-compiler: NULL3D_SHADER_COMPILER=1 cargo test -p null3d-shaders --test build && bun tools/shaders.ts && NULL3D_SHADER_COMPILER=1 bun test ./packages/vite-plugin/src/shader-compiler.test.ts ./packages/vite-plugin/src/wgsl.test.ts
scripts.devices: bun tools/shaders.ts && bun tests/real-browsers.ts --allow-no-webgpu --android chrome,brave --lan ipad-safari,ipad-brave
